reasons: Claimed status 'missing' is consistent with the record: no limitation-of-liability, cap or consequential-damages exclusion appears in the cited material, and the rationale documents a targeted sweep ('liability', 'consequential', 'in no event', 'damages', 'indemnif') showing the only 'liability' hits are in the unrelated no-joint-venture clause.

The inserted Section 10.9 is actionable and tracks the preferred position and model language: mutual aggregate cap at the greater of 12 months' fees paid or payable and USD 1,000,000, mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages, and uncapped Excluded Claims for confidentiality, data protection/security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement.
Edit is additive only — the existing 10.8 text is untouched — so it is the smallest edit that reaches the playbook position, and placement in General Provisions is appropriate.

Payment-obligation carve-out (Sections 3 and 4.2) correctly protects the Customer's position and does not create an unlimited Customer liability exposure; deterministic checks (operation applies, cap basis, no unlimited Customer liability) all pass.

Comment is accurate, concise, in first person plural, correctly states the playbook position and that indemnities/confidentiality sit outside the cap, and the rationale preserves the 12-months-fees fallback.
